after_snippet:
from packaging.markers import Marker
# In 26.0, Version parsing is only attempted on specific marker keys
m = Marker("extra == 'dev'")
result = m.evaluate({'extra': 'dev'})
assert result is True
before_snippet:
from packaging.markers import Marker
# In 25.0, markers would try to parse arbitrary strings as Version for comparison
m = Marker("extra == 'dev'")
result = m.evaluate({'extra': 'dev'})
assert result is True
title: Marker comparison now only parses Version on specific marker keys
